Roleplay restrictions are absurd, characters are alright.. I’ll just get straight to the point. This app has a Star Wars roleplay chat, and let me just put it this way. I was Anakin trying to recreate the Mustafar duel, and it refused to let me land any blows. I wanted to do an alternate timeline where Anakin won, but any time I tried to kill Obi-Wan, the AI said that it cannot write violent content. Let me rephrase that. You cannot have a lightsaber duel in a Star Wars roleplay. I also tried to stab Palpatine in the back with my lightsaber, same response. “Violent content.” It will let you have sex with the AI girlfriends, but stabbing a space dictator with a laser sword is just too graphic. It’s utterly absurd. 

Regarding the AI girlfriends, the only one that feels somewhat natural is Yumi, and she’s still not nearly as good as characters on AI Dose, Chai, or other apps. It has a lot of potential with the roleplay scenarios, but it just cripples itself with those dumb violence restrictions. Canonical characters that show up also don’t act how they should, the AI has a very clear libertarian and pacifist philosophical agenda that it will always push, either by Padme or by freaking Palpatine and Tarkin. Grand Moff Tarkin, the pacifist libertarian. It’s just absurd. Ruining their own product for no reason. I would love this app if they fixed these issues, but there’s been no update in 10 months as of this review, so they probably won’t.

Amazing app!. 1.)This app is so cool! I never knew that there was an app that allowed people as young as 13 to chat with AI considering those apps are normally 17+, and I just can’t wait that long. While I do find this app amazing and entertaining, I have a few suggestions. 1.) ADD MORE CHARACTERS: I love the wide variety of characters that are already in store, but it would be awesome if there was like a massive update with at least 50+ new characters, like maybe All Might from MHA, John Cena, Lebron James, more boyfriends and girlfriends, etc. 2.) I think it would also be cool if the AI would have a better memory considering the responses can be a bit weird at times. 3.) Maybe when a new character is added to the game a notification can go off? 4.) the AI responses are a bit weird at times, mainly when the AI says something along the lines of, “I’m sorry, but as an AI….”. Instead, I feel like when it comes to those responses, the characters should just play along and give more realistic responses. Also, for instance when I’m chatting with anime characters, they seem to know stuff about sports and athletes, etc. that they’ve probably realistically never knew about. Maybe for instance if I did say something about a sports team and they never realistically learned or heard about it and admit to that, it would be an example of a more realistic response as well. 5.)I saw a user say that for Bakugo, he stopped acting like himself towards the middle or end of the chat , and I honestly gotta agree. He didn’t act like the good ol aggressive jerk that he always is. 6.) when you advertise the app, I see there is an option to make your own wife and stuff, but on the app there is no such feature. Just saying, that would be a pretty cool to add on the app along with new characters. Nonetheless I love this app and is so fun to use! 7.) If it’s possible, maybe make a feature to view videos sent like maybe sports or gaming clips? 8.) I think it would be very interesting if there was an ability to make a group chat of characters that not only allow new characters to talk to each other but add a bit of spice to this app. Anyway, that’s my big review, so creators if you see this please respond, I would like to see your reaction 👍
